title: ContextForge Manifest
description: Dependency graph manifest for a game project, generated by an extractor. Never hand-edited.

project_root.description: Absolute path to the target game project root.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this manifest was generated.

nodes.description: All discovered nodes (scenes, scripts, modules, assets) in the project.

engine.description: Which engine/framework this node belongs to.

type.description: The kind of source artifact this node represents.

contract.description: The public interface this node exposes.

depends_on.description: Node ids this node references directly (parsed from source).

depended_on_by.description: Node ids that reference this node. Computed from the full edge set, never parsed directly.

lock.description: Runtime lock state for multi-agent safety. Optional — added by the server, not by extractors.

slot.description: Declared slot contract for asset nodes (e.g. expected animations, format, dimensions). Optional.

exports.description: Exported vars (Godot @export) or JS named/default exports. Each entry is a human-readable signature string.

signals.description: Godot signal declarations. Empty array for JS nodes.

requires.description: Autoloads, singletons, or globals this node assumes exist at runtime.

slot.description: Declared slot contract for asset nodes (e.g. expected animations, format, dimensions). Optional.

status.description: Whether this node is currently locked for editing.

holder.description: Free-form session/agent identifier of who holds the lock. Empty string when status is 'free'.

locked_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the lock was acquired. Empty string when status is 'free'.

format.description: Expected asset file format (e.g. glb, png, wav).

expected_animations.description: List of required animation clip names for character/model slots.

rigged.description: Whether a 3D model slot requires a skeletal rig/skin.

max_size_kb.description: Maximum allowed file size in kilobytes.
